general_information.Syllabus Name: Data Mining Project_Dự án khai phá dữ liệu
general_information.Description: The objective of the course is to help students apply the knowledge about data mining to apply in practice to solve problems to ensure requirements such as: - Use the discussed data mining techniques in practice, - Identify relevant data mining techniques from research articles for a given problem, - Formulate a methodological description on how a problem ought to be solved using data mining, - Analyse results and models from a data mining project. - Identify problems for which data mining is appropriate to use, - Select appropriate evaluation methods based on the data mining task at hand. - Learn about the legal and ethical aspects of data collection and use. - Analyze data mining problems and reason about the most appropriate methods to apply to a given dataset and knowledge extraction need. - Implement basic pre-processing, association mining, classification and clustering algorithms. - Apply and reflect on advanced pre-processing, association mining, classification and clustering algorithms. - Work efficiently in groups and evaluate the algorithms on real-world problems.
general_information.StudentTasks: # Choose appropriate project and form group. # Divide and schedule work among members. # Produce document and product according to project requirement and member work share. # Defend work infront of examination board, showing both project results and individual responsibility.
general_information.Tools: #Programming language: Python, R,… #Tools: Rapid Miner, Weka, Apache Spark #Database: o Kaggle: https://www.kaggle.com/ o Data Mining Cup: http://www.data-mining-cup.de o KDD Cup: https://www.kdd.org/kdd-cup
general_information.Note: Completion Criteria (in addition to grade criteria): * Students can prove that they create the product themselves * No fatal defect in software product (the students can't demonstrate)
